name: Un'Goro Crater
summary: Un'Goro Crater is a sunken, primordial jungle tucked between the arid wastes of Tanaris and Silithus. Dominated by roaming dinosaurs, living elementals, and a central volcano, this lush caldera is filled with ancient Titan relics and power crystals whose origins remain a profound mystery.

sections.title: The God Lands
sections.body: Sandwiched between desert expanses, Un'Goro Crater defies the geography of southern Kalimdor. Ancient night elf records detailing the War of the Shifting Sands note that the insectoid Qiraji were turned back at the crater's edges, unable to penetrate what their tongue named the 'God Lands.' Scholars theorize the caldera served as a testing ground or ancient dwelling for the Titans during the shaping of Kalimdor. Stone pylons rise along the ridges, humming with energy, while crystal formations of blue, red, green, and yellow sprout through the primeval earth.

sections.title: A Savage Ecosystem
sections.body: Un'Goro contains no cities, towns, or native humanoid societies. Instead, life thrives in an untamed, primeval state. Apex devilsaurs stalk the flats of Terror Run, predatory bloodpetals lash out in the marshlands, and oozes creep across the tar pits of Lakkari. At the heart of the crater looms Fire Plume Ridge, an active volcanic peak teeming with hostile fire elementals led by the entity Blazerunner. For explorers and skinners, the basin offers unmatched natural wealth—including the coveted hides of devilsaurs—provided one survives the food chain.

sections.title: Marshal's Refuge
sections.body: Civilized presence in the crater is limited almost entirely to Marshal's Refuge, an elevated camp tucked into the northern cliffs. Led by Williden Marshal, an expedition of scientists, naturalists, and fortune seekers attempted to catalogue the basin's treasures only to be battered by the monstrous wildlife and driven to high ground. Today, the refuge serves as an embattled staging ground for intrepid travelers studying the crater's mysterious power crystals, mapping volcanic activity, and keeping a watchful eye on encroaching silithid swarms breaching the southern ridges.

faq.q: How do you get into Un'Goro Crater?
faq.answer: Travelers can enter via natural ramps leading down the crater walls: one accessible from the southwestern corner of Tanaris near Thistleshrub Valley, and another leading in from northeastern Silithus. While reckless adventurers sometimes leap down the cliffs, the fall is fatal without magical assistance. Marshal's Refuge in the north provides flight connections to Gadgetzan and Cenarion Hold.

faq.q: What are the colored power crystals used for?
aliases: red blue green yellow crystals ungoro
faq.answer: Scattered across the jungle floor are red, blue, green, and yellow Power Crystals. With guidance from the gnome researcher J.D. Collie at Marshal's Refuge, explorers can decipher instructions for using these crystals at the Northern, Eastern, and Western Pylons. Combining specific colors at the appropriate pylons harnesses latent Titan energies to fashion defensive or restorative charms.

faq.q: Why is Un'Goro lush despite being surrounded by deserts?
faq.answer: Scholars believe Un'Goro's unnatural vibrancy is artificial, stemming from the Titans who shaped the world. Titanic conduits, warm volcanic geothermal activity from Fire Plume Ridge, and ancient ley energy nourish an isolated, hyper-accelerated ecosystem that resists the arid conditions of neighbouring Tanaris and Silithus.

faq.q: Why did the Qiraji call this place the 'God Lands'?
faq.answer: According to tablets translated from the War of the Shifting Sands, the insect swarms halted their advance at the crater's threshold. Geologist Larksbane's translations reveal the Qiraji viewed the basin as the domain of the Titans—specifically referencing ancient creators like Aman'Thul—whose lingering wards prevented the Swarm from claiming the region.

faq.q: What is Un'Goro Soil used for?
faq.answer: Piles of rich, potent dirt rest across the crater basin. When harvested, this soil can be paired with Tharlendris seeds in an Evergreen Pouch to cultivate Morrowgrain, a mystical herb intensely sought after by researchers in Thunder Bluff, Darnassus, and the Cenarion Circle.

faq.q: Are there any humanoid settlements or dungeons here?
faq.answer: There are no instances, dungeons, or indigenous humanoid societies in Un'Goro Crater. The only lasting settlement is Marshal's Refuge, a small expedition outpost on the northern rim. Beyond isolated hermit hunters or lost explorers, the rest of the caldera is entirely wild.

angles.text: The rich moisture of the basin sustains rare flora, serving as one of the few places in Kalimdor where Blindweed, Dreamfoil, and Golden Sansam flourish together alongside Firebloom on the volcano's slopes.
The sheer crater walls and the crags of Fire Plume Ridge are dense with Mithril Deposits and Rich Thorium Veins, making the zone a premier destination for high-end ore.
Cenarion Circle druids study Un'Goro's isolated ecosystem and harvest its rich soil to propagate Morrowgrain, seeking to understand the pure, untamed life force sustaining the caldera.
Alliance naturalists rally around Williden Marshal and J.D. Collie at Marshal's Refuge, racing to decipher the Titan pylons while safeguarding Darnassus researchers gathering soil samples.
Horde adventurers often arrive via Tanaris to test their prowess against legendary devilsaurs and assist the herbalists of Thunder Bluff in cultivating Morrowgrain from Un'Goro's primeval dirt.
